mentions.description: A desktop app by bbx for easily browsing, tagging, and rating images. It never modifies (only reads) the user's files, and all data is stored in a local SQLite database. Described as 'Think Eagle app but private, offline, and easy to use.'
mentions.problem: Implied problem: existing image organizers (like Eagle) may not be private, offline, or easy to use; this app keeps everything local without touching the user's files.
mentions.audience: Users who want to privately organize, tag, and rate their personal image collections offline
mentions.author: bbx
